content.comment_body: There is no [product_name] module that supports thermocouple inputs directly, only PT100 sensors are supported. To work with thermocouples, you'll need to use a signal converter that transforms TC to a 0-10V signal.

It can be more cost effective to use PT100 sensors together with [product_name] modules that are designed for PT100, but check if you can use three-wire connections and consider what types of analog processing you plan. Another option is to use a K-type thermocouple to 0-10V converter, which allows you to utilize the standard analog inputs on a [product_name]. For instance, [url] offers converters that typically cost around 60 to 100 EUR.

I've used a third-party device to convert type K thermocouple signals to 0-10V for analog inputs. It works well and is reasonably priced, though you'll need to purchase a programming cable separately.

analysis.insight_summary: Forum users point out that [product_name] modules do not support thermocouple inputs natively and only PT100 sensors are directly compatible. Solutions such as using external converters to adapt thermocouple signals for analog inputs are suggested, along with general advice on sensor types, wiring, and cost considerations.
analysis.user_expectations: Users want either direct support for thermocouple inputs in [product_name] modules or a straightforward way to integrate them, ideally with minimal additional hardware.
